facts.fact: The page's benchmark estimate puts Instagram ad cost per click often in the range of $0.70 to $2, depending on objective and audience.
facts.quote: Cost per click:** often in the range of $0.70 to $2, depending on your objective and audience.

facts.fact: The page's benchmark estimate puts Instagram ad cost per thousand impressions (CPM) at roughly $8 to $14, with Stories and Reels frequently on the lower end.
facts.quote: roughly $8 to $14, with Stories and Reels frequently on the lower end.

facts.fact: The page says a practical starting daily budget for a local business is often $10 to $30 a day.
facts.quote: a practical starting point is often $10 to $30 a day

facts.fact: Instagram ads have no hard minimum spend, so a campaign can start with a modest daily budget, though enough spend is needed for the algorithm to learn.
facts.quote: No hard minimum: you can start with a modest daily budget, though you need enough spend for the algorithm to learn.

facts.fact: Instagram ads run through the same system as Facebook ads, Meta Ads Manager, because Instagram is owned by Meta, and one campaign can run on Instagram, Facebook, or both.
facts.quote: Instagram ads run through the same system as Facebook ads, Meta Ads Manager, because Instagram is owned by Meta.

facts.fact: The page lists five Instagram ad campaign objectives relevant to local businesses: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, and Sales.
facts.quote: Awareness:** get your business in front of as many nearby people as possible.

facts.fact: The page states the article was published on July 7, 2026.
The page states that Instagram cost per click is often between $0.70 and $2.
facts.quote: Instagram ad costs are similar to Facebook's, with cost per click often between $0.70 and $2 and CPMs around $8 to $14

facts.fact: The page states that Instagram CPMs are around $8 to $14, varying by industry and location.
facts.quote: with cost per click often between $0.70 and $2 and CPMs around $8 to $14, though these vary by industry and location

facts.fact: The page says many local businesses can reach a meaningful audience and learn what works with a daily Instagram ad budget of ten to thirty dollars.
facts.quote: Ten to thirty dollars a day is enough for many local businesses to reach a meaningful audience and learn what works.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page says users can get started with its service from $30 a day.
facts.quote: or check [pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing) to get started from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states it offers TV and connected TV advertising across more than 100 premium channels.
facts.quote: plus TV and connected TV across 100+ premium channels.
